contraprovas_minimas: compile refuses when website-only/Shop proof is missing
AdSet provider refusal stops saga without retry
runtime_tasks_before_canary.definicao_de_pronto: Canary gate has either official website-only field/read-back proof or selected-account non-Shop-eligible proof, and omission/refusal behavior is tested.

runtime_tasks_before_canary.objetivo: Require the minimal Fable AssetSupplyManifest/policy receipt for the selected static image before compile and approval.
arquivos_esperados: backend/app/asset_vault/* or creative supply chain adapter
runtime_tasks_before_canary.definicao_de_pronto: Every asset_ref in the plan is bound to content_sha256+supply_sha256+policy_receipt_ref CLEAR/AUTHORIZED and exact Meta image_hash.

runtime_tasks_before_canary.objetivo: Harden P0 reconciliation so post-dispatch absence/doubt does not automatically release a new create.
contraprovas_minimas: FAILED-from-ambiguous does not permit automatic new approval
runtime_tasks_before_canary.definicao_de_pronto: Ambiguous dispatched steps require manual closure and cannot silently unlock duplicate creation.

runtime_tasks_before_canary.objetivo: Separate validate receipt/reconcile/read flags from dispatch/create flag while keeping create requiring both create+ledger.
contraprovas_minimas: validate receipt can be written with ledger open and create closed
reconciliation/receipt read do not require dispatch flag
create refuses unless META_CREATE_PAUSED_ENABLED and META_CREATE_LEDGER_WRITE_ENABLED are both 1
runtime_tasks_before_canary.definicao_de_pronto: Flags express four acts: validate, ledger receipt, dispatch create, read-only reconciliation; no flag opens a broader act than its name.

runtime_tasks_before_canary.objetivo: Prove Page/Instagram/placements identity for the selected canary or restrict placements safely.
contraprovas_minimas: missing Instagram proof either blocks or emits official Facebook-only placement subset
read-back compares page and IG actor when present
runtime_tasks_before_canary.definicao_de_pronto: The selected canary has explicit identity/placement receipt and cannot serve through an unapproved Page/Instagram actor.

after_runtime_tasks: Run local focused tests and document gates.
Request separate authorization for official migration only after tasks pass.
Run validate_only only as a separate authorized act.
Run create_paused only as a later separate authorized act.
